desc.testo: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited operates a range of equity, commodity, fixed income and currency markets through its wholly owned subsidiaries The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited (SEHK), Hong Kong Futures Exchange Limited (HKFE) and London Metal Exchange (LME).
desc.trad: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited gestisce una gamma di mercati azionari, delle materie prime, del reddito fisso e valutari attraverso le sue società interamente controllate The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited (SEHK), Hong Kong Futures Exchange Limited (HKFE) e London Metal Exchange (LME).
